description: Contract event logs via eth_getLogs filtered by contract and topics (topic0 = event signature hash). Raw logs, newest first; default last 100 blocks, max 5000 (auto-chunked for public RPC limits). Example: {address:"0x8335…2913", topic0:"0xddf2…b3ef", chain:"base", blocks:"50"}. $0.003 USDC.
name: chain_events
